code: # Run once with an Analyst-tier key. Writes cg_universe_master.parquet # with all the slug ↔ numeric_id ↔ name ↔ symbol mappings. library(httr) library(jsonlite) library(purrr) library(tibble) library(dplyr) library(stringr) library(arrow)  key <- Sys.getenv("CG_PRO_KEY") stopifnot(nzchar(key))  pro_get <- function(path, query = NULL) {   url  <- sprintf("https://pro-api.coingecko.com/api/v3/%s", path)   resp <- httr::GET(url, query = query,                     httr::add_headers(`x-cg-pro-api-key` = key,                                       `User-Agent` = "crypto2/coingecko-harvest"),                     httr::timeout(60))   if (httr::status_code(resp) != 200) return(NULL)   jsonlite::fromJSON(httr::content(resp, "text", encoding = "UTF-8")) }  # 1. Active + inactive universes (slug lists) active   <- pro_get("coins/list",                     query = list(include_platform = "true")) inactive <- pro_get("coins/list",                     query = list(include_platform = "true",                                  status           = "inactive"))  all_slugs <- unique(c(active$id, inactive$id)) status_lookup <- setNames(   c(rep("active",   length(active$id)),     rep("inactive", length(inactive$id))),   c(active$id, inactive$id) )  # 2. Per-slug detail → numeric_id, name, symbol, genesis_date extract_one <- function(slug) {   d <- pro_get(sprintf("coins/%s", slug),                query = list(localization   = "false",                             tickers        = "false",                             market_data    = "false",                             community_data = "false",                             developer_data = "false",                             sparkline      = "false"))   if (is.null(d)) return(NULL)   image_url  <- d$image$large %||% d$image$small %||% d$image$thumb   numeric_id <- as.integer(stringr::str_extract(     image_url, "(?<=/coins/images/)\\d+"))   tibble::tibble(     numeric_id        = numeric_id,     slug              = slug,     name              = d$name,     symbol            = d$symbol,     status            = status_lookup[[slug]],     genesis_date      = as.Date(d$genesis_date %||% NA_character_),     asset_platform_id = d$asset_platform_id %||% NA_character_,     web_slug          = d$web_slug %||% slug,     harvested_at      = Sys.time()   ) }  # At ~500 req/min on the Analyst tier, ~40 000 calls = ~80 min. mapping <- purrr::map_dfr(all_slugs,                           purrr::possibly(extract_one, otherwise = NULL),                           .progress = TRUE)  arrow::write_parquet(mapping, "cg_universe_master.parquet")

title: crypto2 (development version)
text: Added four functions mirror CMC-side API pull CoinGecko, API key required. Column names match crypto_list() / crypto_listings() / crypto_history() / crypto_info() direct equivalent, downstream code already consumes CMC tibble works CG tibble . cg_list() — active coin universe via documented /coins/list (one HTTP call) enriched market-cap rank + internal numeric id via paginated /coins/markets. cg_listings() — current snapshot active coins (paginated /coins/markets price_change_percentage=1h,24h,7d,14d,30d,200d,1y). cg_history() — full daily OHLC + volume + market-cap history. Uses undocumented website-host endpoints (price_charts/{slug}/{vs}/max.json, market_cap/{slug}/{vs}/max.json, ohlc/{numeric_id}/series/{vs}/max.json) return one coin’s entire history one HTTP call bound documented 30 req/min rate-limit. cg_info() — per-coin metadata (description, logos, categories, contract addresses across chains, links) via /coins/{slug} documented host. cg_history_by_id() — companion cg_history() addresses coins numeric ID instead slug, calling www.coingecko.com/{price_charts,market_cap,ohlc}/{numeric_id}/.... Useful accumulated snapshots collected numeric IDs whose slugs since removed CoinGecko’s public routing: numeric ID still serves historical data (least dense early-ID range). function defaults active universe cg_list() — blind 1:N iteration work numeric-ID space sparse (max ~102M ~15k populated mid 2026). Survivorship bias caveat. CoinGecko’s free tier exposes active coins — delisted coins return 404 /coins/list /coins/{slug}. build survivorship-bias-corrected dataset CoinGecko, snapshot periodically (daily/weekly) accumulate union numeric IDs ever observed external database, feed union cg_history_by_id() refresh. Coins delisted first snapshot preserved via numeric ID. Endpoints reverse-engineered data-url/data-chart-urls attributes embedded https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/{slug} page HTML (website’s JS calls ). API key, signup. requests use browser-like User-Agent defeat Cloudflare’s cheapest bot heuristics; override via options(crypto2.cg_user_agent = "...").
